context: Adds a length check to frame header parsing and returns a typed error instead of indexing blindly.
explanation: parse_frame_header previously indexed straight into buf without checking its length, so any caller passing fewer than 3 bytes - such as a truncated read off the network - would panic. The new version validates the length up front and returns a typed FrameTooShort error via a Result, turning a potential remotely-triggered panic into ordinary, recoverable error handling.
